description: Light multiply via 128KB exact LUT: REGRESSED +8.8ms world (121.8->130.6). On DOSBox, 3 extra byte loads + index math + init-check per pixel cost more than the 3 IMUL+add+shr+clamp chains they replaced. Memory is NOT cheaper than ALU in this emulator.

Texture row via __builtin_ctz shift instead of *width: REGRESSED +4.2ms world (121.8->125.98 instrumented). x86 shl-by-cl needs the count in CL, adding per-pixel register shuffling; also showed the LUT was the bigger half (130.6 combined - 126.0 shift-only).

description: Depth buffer -> uint32 float-bit keys (exact: all depths non-negative, bits order as int). asi.learning: DOSBox op-cost parity kills all shuffling: float vs int, span-level vs tri-level anchoring, FIST vs FADD. NOT an anchoring problem: op VOLUME per tri is irreducible below ~setup+walk unless tris are CULLED earlier. THE VALID NEXT AXES: (a) flex backface/model-cluster culling before the mesh loop, (b) world block z-run/texel-run split (drops per-px branch+advance on passing runs), (c) batch face calls

description: BIG SWING DEAD: per-face texture surface cache (Quake2 r_surf.c D_CacheSurface lineage): mip0-3 composite of imagemip x band-packed light keyed on per-face style signature; span hot loop fetches pre-lit block; fallback per-pixel. WORLD 108,671->901,113 (+730%), frame 161k->1.19M, RENDER 12.76% >2LSB. FATAL: tutorial2 bench animates lightstyles EVERY frame => every visible face rebuilds its composite EVERY frame, and composite per texel ~= direct per-px cost under DOSBox op-parity, while mip0 near-face rects (272x272) composite far more texels than the spans ever draw. q2dos's cache wins only because Q2 light is static (build once per map, amortize over 1000s of frames) — the amortization precondition does not exist here. Surface-cache mechanism exhausted for animated-light H2.

asi.hypothesis: pre-lit surface cache amortizes per-px light+modulate out of world inner loop
asi.learning: MECHANISM FALSIFIED: (1) amortization requires cross-frame reuse; bench lightstyles animate every frame => rebuild-per-frame; (2) composite cost per texel ~= direct cost under flat ~4.4cy/op so no per-texel win to amortize; (3) rect-bounded composite area >> span-bounded px for mip0 big faces. Harness gate now verified (stale-PPM hole fixed, f20dcbd0); ALSO: earlier identical-86% failure signature was the stale-PPM artifact, NOT the flip — layout flip (-10.9ms present) is UN-INDICTED and should be re-attempted.
asi.next_action_hint: re-attempt the proven -10.9ms present-layout flip (SW_RGBA blue-low + all consumer sites) — its earlier gate failure was the same stale-PPM artifact; then brush per-face cone cull; do NOT revisit surface cache

description: B1.1+B1.2 combined: recursive far->near BSP painter walk + opaque compare-drop with painter_opaque gate (warp/undulate/entities keep z-compare). Gates PASS 0-diff (tie-diffs eliminated by the gate; UNDULATE displacement bands forced z semantics). PERF REGRESSION: world 97.1->101.2ms, frame 142.9->147.4, total 155.6K->164.1K (+8.5K). Mechanism: compare-drop saves ~2 ops/px but painter floods ~20% MORE pixels through full shading (texel/modulate/store) that z-reject used to skip. Painter pays ONLY with span clipping (edge list = zero overdraw), i.e. B1.3 must be implemented as one unit. Reverted to dc863377.

asi.hypothesis: painter order + compare-drop = free shading win
asi.learning: z-compare is NOT waste: it rejects overdraw pre-shading at 2 ops/px vs ~15 ops/px shade cost. Painter+flood loses unless spans are clipped to zero-overdraw (edge list). B1.1 walk overhead alone +2.3ms (recursion+locality) is the staging cost any B1.3 must also overcome. Tie/coplanar class fixed via SURF_WARP|UNDULATE exemption in painter_opaque gate - keep that gating logic if B1.3 resurfaces.
asi.next_action_hint: B3 next (flex/entity gradient 16.16 batching, est -8..12ms, no ordering risk). B1.3 (full edge-list + span clipping + sky-from-coverage) is a deep build: ONLY do as unit; expected payoff world ~97->~50ms IF vertex costs amortize; verify per-row span-clip cost model by prototyping counters first (measure unique covered px = current estimate 0.8*walked).

description: B3a: BSP descent light sampling replaces linear full-face scan in sample_bsp_light. Origin of the 15.9ms phantom: flex_light called ~8x/frame; the sampler scanned ALL world faces (~53k instrs/call). New sw_light_descend walks the BSP with exact vertical-ray column pruning ([-0.01..2048] crossing band, widened +-0.5 for float safety), leaf faces via leaffaces, tie-break (min drop, min face_index) bit-identical to ascending linear scan; original face test factored unchanged into sw_light_face_test. entities 28,936->13,459 (-15.5ms), frame 142,897->127,420, total 155,622->144,966. Gates all PASS 0-diff. Intermediates: per-origin memo probe showed 0% hit rate (lightstyles animate every frame -> generation bump invalidates); stripped cache + probe scaffolding before keep.

asi.learning: memo falsified (0% hits: style fingerprint changes every frame in bench world). Root cause was O(num_faces) linear face scan per sample; BSP descent with exact ray-column pruning + order-independent tie-break preserves bit-exact selection while making sampling ~O(depth + leaf faces).

description: W6 MMX 2px-pair PMULLW modulate in opaque span loop

asi.hypothesis: PMULLW pair modulate ~30ops/2px replaces ~21ops/px extract+IMUL+pack chain -> -6ops/px
asi.rollback_reason: world +6.4ms AND 36% px gate fail (green mask 0x07E0 applied post-shift instead of 0x003F). Perf fail alone is fatal: DOSBox flat model gives MMX NO IPC gain; pair bookkeeping + asm-block compiler barrier (mm regs invisible to scheduler, no clobbers allowed) swamped the instr-count savings.
asi.learning_mmx_harness: HARNESS FACT: DOSBox Staging 0.82.2 pentium core executes MMX opcodes (emms/movd run) but reports cpuid-mmx=0, and models MMX at flat per-instruction parity. Therefore in-harness MMX can never beat tight C: it only pays on real PMMX silicon (true mul latency, U/V pairing, lane parallelism). REAL-HW docs only: recommend SetMtrr/USWC for LFB, and this C still gains from Pentium pairing quirks.
asi.learning_pair_census: per-pair GP bookkeeping (accA/accB, lidxA/lidxB with 2 IMULs each, iuB/itB, pair form, dword store) ~= 15+ ops/2px; without an IPC gift it eats the ~6 op modulate saving
asi.next_action_hint: axis closed: no more modulation restructures pass gates under this harness.
